display.purpose: The hero readout: active population id or metric at the top of the main column. The one place a number gets large.

title.purpose: Tab labels, card titles, table headers, active navigator rows.

body.purpose: Running text and descriptions. Cap measure at 65 to 75ch for long-form prose.

mono.purpose: Every gene id, count, p-value, logFC, breadcrumb, and dataset slug.

shadows.name: resting-lift
shadows.purpose: Hairline separation under cards and panels at rest. Barely there.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Response when a tile or card is hovered or becomes active, paired with a 2px translate.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals and the update prompt only. The one deep shadow.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft orange halo under the primary action button. The only colored shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Orange focus ring on inputs, paired with a Signal Orange border.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state transition.

motion.name: duration-med
motion.purpose: Card lift, tab switch, fade-in and slide-in entrances.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action per view (Compare, Retry). Orange fill with a soft glow.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 3v18M16 3v18M3 8h5M3 16h5M16 8h5M16 16h5"/></svg>Compare all cells</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#F28E2B; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk','Source Sans 3',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(242,142,43,0.3); transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#e07a1e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F28E2B; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The everyday bordered control (Changelog, toggles). White or transparent with a hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { background:#fff; color:#27251e; border:1px solid #d4cfc8; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 12px; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk','Source Sans 3',sans-serif; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background:#f4f1ed; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F28E2B; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Navigator filter and gene search. Hairline border, orange focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search by id, marker, or type…" />
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#fff; color:#27251e; border:1px solid #e7e3de; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk','Source Sans 3',sans-serif; font-size:12px; outline:none; transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#938f88; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#F28E2B; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(242,142,43,0.15); }

components.name: Gene Chip
components.description: A selected gene token. Cool blue text on a faint row-selected tint, mono.
components.css: .ds-chip { background:#e5ecf4; color:#4C78A8; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 9px; font-family:'Geist Mono','IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background:#d8e3f0; border-color:#4C78A8; }

components.name: Underline Tab
components.description: The main view switcher. Muted at rest, ink with an orange underline when active.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:4px; border-bottom:1px solid #e7e3de; } .ds-tab { padding:8px 16px; background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; color:#65625c; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk','Source Sans 3',sans-serif; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; transition:color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color:#27251e; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.02); } .ds-tab--active { color:#27251e; border-bottom-color:#F28E2B; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Navigator Row
components.description: Signature: a population row. Colored dot, mono id, truncated marker label. Active row gets a 3px orange left border and a cool selected fill.
components.css: .ds-navlist { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#fff; } .ds-navrow { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 14px; background:transparent; border:none; border-left:3px solid transparent; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; color:#3d3a34; font-family:'Hanken Grotesk','Source Sans 3',sans-serif; font-size:12px; transition:background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-navrow:hover { background:#f4f1ed; } .ds-navrow--active { background:#ede8e2; border-left-color:#F28E2B; color:#27251e; font-weight:500; } .ds-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-id { font-family:'Geist Mono','IBM Plex Mono',monospace; min-width:28px; } .ds-label { color:#65625c; font-size:11px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Contrast Pill
components.description: The hero group readout: a colored dot plus a mono count in a faint tinted pill. Normal blue vs Obese red.
components.html: 3 Normalvs3 Obese
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:12px; font-family:'Geist Mono','IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:#3d3a34; } .ds-pill--normal { background:rgba(76,120,168,0.09); border:1px solid rgba(76,120,168,0.22); } .ds-pill--obese { background:rgba(228,87,86,0.09); border:1px solid rgba(228,87,86,0.22); } .ds-vs { color:#65625c; font-size:12px; margin:0 6px; } .ds-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; }

narrative.overview: HypoExplorer reads like ink on paper. Warm paper surfaces, hairline stone rules, and prose set in Hanken Grotesk. The data is the ink: every number, gene id, count, and p-value is set in Geist Mono so figures line up in columns and never hide inside running text. Color is rationed. It stays out of the chrome and appears only when it carries a result, a red point is up-regulated, a blue point is down-regulated, a single orange element is the thing you have selected right now. The system is dense without being loud, framing live scientific output in the quietest possible chrome. It explicitly rejects the dashboard-SaaS reflexes that scientific tools tend to drift into: gradient hero metrics, purple washes, glassmorphism, and color used for decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-on-paper restraint: warm off-white paper, never #000 for text or chrome.
Color earns its place by encoding meaning (direction, group, pathway source, selection).
Mono for every figure; Sans for every sentence.
Flat at rest; depth appears only on hover, selection, and overlays.
One accent (orange) per view, marking the single active thing.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange marks at most one active element per view. Its rarity is the signal; a second orange selection in frame means the design is lying about what is active.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Red is up and Obese. Blue is down and Normal. These bindings are absolute and centralized in one module. Color is never chosen for looks; if you cannot name what a color encodes, it should be a neutral.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: If it is a figure (id, count, statistic, coordinate), it is Geist Mono. Numbers never sit in Sans, so columns of data always align.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Section labels are 10px, 700 weight, 0.12em tracked, uppercase, and muted slate. They orient without shouting.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest with a hairline border and at most the resting lift. Shadows deepen only in response to hover, selection, or an overlay taking the screen.

rules.name: The Thick Edge Means State Rule
rules.body: The only edges thicker than 1px encode state, never decoration: the 4px top accent strip carries the active population's color, and the 3px left border on the active navigator row carries the selection.

dos: Do bind color to meaning: Up Red (#E45756) for up-regulated and Obese, Down Blue (#4C78A8) for down-regulated and Normal, the four database hues for pathway source.
Do reserve Signal Orange (#F28E2B) for exactly one active or selected element per view.
Do set every number, id, and statistic in Geist Mono so figures align in columns.
Do define surfaces with 1px hairline borders and keep them flat at rest; let shadows deepen only on hover, selection, and overlays.
Do let the 4px accent strip carry the active population's color as the primary brand moment.
Do tint neutrals toward the warm stone family; the darkest text is Ink (#27251e), never black.
donts: Don't use #000 for text or chrome, or #fff for text. The system bottoms out at Ink #27251e on Paper #faf8f5 / Panel #ffffff.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent or use color decoratively. If you cannot name what a color encodes, make it a neutral.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a decorative stripe on cards or callouts. The only thick edges in the system encode state.
Don't reach for gradient hero metrics, purple-to-blue washes, glassmorphism, or identical icon-and-heading card grids.
Don't animate layout properties or add bounce. Transitions are 120ms / 200ms on the standard ease, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't let chrome compete with the plot. When in doubt, remove a border, mute a label, or drop a color before adding one.
